title: Mouse holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M22 74 Q8 74 10 62 Q12 52 22 56' stroke='#f6c9d4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='70' rx='26' ry='19' fill='#a9b4d6'/>
    <ellipse cx='46' cy='73' rx='19' ry='13' fill='#c6cde8'/>

    <ellipse cx='34' cy='87' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f2a8bb'/>

    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='26' cy='38' r='12' fill='#a9b4d6'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='38' r='7' fill='#f2a8bb'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='12' fill='#a9b4d6'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='38' r='7' fill='#f2a8bb'/>

    <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='22' fill='#bcc5e3'/>

    <circle cx='38' cy='45' r='4' fill='#2e2a55'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='45' r='4' fill='#2e2a55'/>

    <circle cx='55.5' cy='43.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>

    <circle cx='46' cy='53' r='3.2' fill='#f2a8bb'/>

    <path d='M34 52 L20 49 M34 56 L21 58 M58 52 L72 49 M58 56 L71 58' stroke='#dfe4f5' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- heart held in paws -->
    <path d='M46 66 C40 58 30 60 30 67 C30 73 40 78 46 82 C52 78 62 73 62 67 C62 60 52 58 46 66 Z' fill='#ff5a8a'/>
    <path d='M40 65 C37 62 33 63 33 67' stroke='#ffb3c9' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- paws on heart -->
    <circle cx='33' cy='68' r='5' fill='#bcc5e3'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='68' r='5' fill='#bcc5e3'/>
  </g>
